_readme: Single source of truth for pricing. Every price on the site, the calculator, the JSON-LD and the Node quote API (server/) read from this file. Edit, commit, push to main.
outsideAreaNote: You're just outside our TS postcode pricing. We still cover you, but we'll confirm the price by message first.
largeJobNote: For more than 2,000 appliances or multi-site work we'll put together a site plan and a fixed price.
